same_information_and_budget: Four spans and readiness all supplied equally; three DMA modes same arena/pins/lanes/public serial NEXT-DONE/cache-CQ protocol. CPU direct buffer does not need artificial arena/DMA fees. No extra payload buffer, small-transfer allowance or private translation feedback.

required_premises: actual accepted current hardware identity and software build
one online hart, actual accepted FENCE.I I/D cache semantics
Sv39 plain4K private anon, single thread and mm user,8 distinct longterm pinned pages
all4 DMA plus PTW/result/spill/RWB quiet before context switch
no outside devmem publisher/no dynamic unbind/hotplug
C2 mlock same8 pages before touch; VM_LOCKED; disabled LRU_GEN/IDLE_PAGE_TRACKING/THP/KSM/NUMA_BALANCING/DAMON; no proc clear_refs/ptrace/mm writers

release_rule: Only after all published jobs actual DONE, CPU data acquisition, restored default contexts, successful fresh marker+sentinel CQ certificate, exact unmap/domain release; then dirty-unpin/unlock/mmput; userspace independently verifies full arena and consumes before munmap.
unsafe_rule: NEXT0, initial/restore certificate failure, restore mismatch, short unmap or uncertified domain release retain mm/pins/locks/owner and do not return. Deadline stops new publications but waits true DONE; no hardware abort or bounded error completion.
repeat: Each of two native runs must restore exact input/arena, verify independent bytes/guards and deliver separate1675B output, verify contexts/pins/mm/ID ownership returned; no past DONE alias.
consumer_completion: all writev bytes and close returned; persistence fsync not claimed
native_acceptance: Read file output back,1675B and exact inputSHA
All32768 arena bytes, headers, untouched guard page, sources unchanged
Four accepted serial descriptors and four actual DONE with finalR/W/B obligations retired
Observed FENCE.I/cache and required error/fault handling on the matching hardware
Default domain restore, CQ receipt, mapping/domain/mm/pin/slot release and repeat recovery
Actual partialmap rollback and process-exit behavior; unsafe failure retention remains a failure requiring platform recovery
timing_gate: Native function and service/cost need acceptance first; actual minimal file task already allows ordinary original-buffer writev, so functional delivery alone is not an A-specific gain.
